translations.web: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
translations.bsb: Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!”
translations.kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
translations.asv: And there came a cloud overshadowing them: and there came a voice out of the cloud, This is my beloved Son: hear ye him.
